decisions.contract: Product uses Agent Preset; runtime instance uses AgentSession.
FullAuto is the only execution behavior; no product approval modes.
NomiFun owns capability, session, preset, authority, credentials, and domain facts.
One in-process nomifun.nomi Runtime owns both Chat and Coding execution through the same canonical Session journal.
Ordinary first-party and third-party plugins are trusted in-process code.
The Kernel owns admission and frozen authority; domain Modules own actions and resource semantics.
Agent revisions select Module and Action grants; Skill, MCP, Provider and typed Resource bindings retain separate owners.
Immutable Agent revision and Session Snapshot freeze the selected execution closure before Turn admission.
Official Agent presets are seeded from the exact current official-agent-seed-manifest.
The Agent editor configures Module and Action grants and resources without exposing a Runtime selector.
Chat and Coding use one adaptive Runtime; no parallel legacy engine or transcript is installed.
The canonical Agent data generation contains no legacy Agent conversion, compatibility reader or dual write.
Agent-only reset replaces Session, Execution, Preset and logs in the same canonical SQLite while preserving non-Agent configuration.
Every migration slice switches all direct consumers and deletes the replaced legacy surface in the same change.
Canonical AgentSession, Turn, Event, Effect, Payload and Resource facts are authoritative; Message and Head projections are rebuildable.
The Unified Plugin Core is the sole plugin implementation and authorization source.
RemoteBinding selects an exact AgentBindingValue and uses explicit open, turn, observe, and cancel.
Lightweight Chat and complete Coding are structural conformance requirements, not a performance benchmark program.
Parallel work is enabled only for multi-task batches with disjoint writes and net speedup; no fixed agent count or EW estimate is a delivery contract.
One official Runtime factory is installed; replaced factories and compatibility branches are physically removed.
AgentSessionId UUIDv7 is the sole Session identity; user-facing Conversation terminology projects that same identity.
Official seeds are role-complete and context-minimal; exact immutable Agent revision closure governs execution.
One irreversible delete closure uses the real Runtime dispose result, purges Session-owned content, and leaves a minimal owner-scoped tombstone; callers provide no synthetic cleanup proof.
Native checkpoints require exact admitted build and binding; closed canonical event history may cross an explicitly validated model or Agent transition as data without granting authority.
Remote token mutation atomically publishes generation and hash; requests authenticated before publication may finish, later old-token requests fail, and existing Sessions are not cascaded.
Runtime disposal performs bounded cancellation, descendant cleanup and explicit unknown-effect handling before physical Session content deletion.
Platform verification follows the current validation manifest and supported desktop viewport; one host never certifies another native platform.

closure_resolutions.canonical_rule: Markdown explains generated artifacts; Rust types, the canonical Agent Store schema, and SessionEvent Registry are the only machine owners.
Every digest artifact is payload plus envelope; payload digest excludes itself, status, evidence, logs, and summary.
Capability search and activation are internal Runtime control operations, not Capabilities and not initial selections.
capability/active-set-committed is the only persistent activation event; requested and failed are transient diagnostics.
Snapshot freezes the selected execution closure; actual admitted build and binding are recorded in native TurnStarted and checked exactly for native checkpoint recovery.
Manifest is the declaration source; registration metadata is derived from real handlers and services, and plugins receive only narrow declared context.

Agent-only reset clears canonical AgentData tables and explicitly owned Session-bound domain relations, releases live Agent references, and preserves non-Agent business configuration and immutable external deduplication identity.
Runtime checkpoints are derived recovery data; canonical event and payload facts own context. Message projections never supply missing Runtime history.

Fresh initialization installs the current canonical schema, preserves non-Agent configuration at the clean-cut boundary, seeds current official Presets, and starts with empty Session and Execution collections.
Canonical errors are uppercase; missing catalog materialization is CAPABILITY_NOT_MATERIALIZED and outside-ceiling is CAPABILITY_NOT_IN_PRESET.
Stable promotes the exact signed RC artifact and signature envelope; any signed-envelope or content change is a new candidate.
Stable may edit schema-backed config of already mounted bundled Packages but provides no user install, lifecycle, SDK, or market.
